title: 黑石AI押注持续兑现：二季度利润跃升26%，数据中心出售能否延续增长？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's start with the big beat, really strong numbers this quarter. John, just how much of that can you give us an idea was powered by an AI wave?
segments.zh: 先看大超预期的业绩，本季度数据非常强劲。约翰，其中有多少是由AI浪潮推动的？

segments.en: Well, it definitely was a heck of a quarter, Danny, and 26% up in earnings on top of 25% last quarter.
segments.zh: 这确实是个出色的季度，丹尼，在上季度增长25%的基础上再增26%。

segments.en: And it was definitely powered by that strategic decision we made to lean into AI in the AI ecosystem.
segments.zh: 这得益于我们押注AI生态系统的战略决策。

segments.en: It really started for us back in 2021 when we bought QTS, this big data center business, and it gave us a front row seat in terms of what's happening around AI.
segments.zh: 早在2021年，我们收购了大型数据中心业务QTS，这让我们在AI领域占据了前排位置。

segments.en: And we made a strategic decision, hey, we should lean in here, not just with data centers, but with Neo Clouds, large language models, electrical equipment, energy.
segments.zh: 我们战略性地决定全面投入，不仅数据中心，还包括Neo云、大语言模型、电气设备和能源。

segments.en: And that decision is paying off, and it's delivering for our clients, which is the most important thing.
segments.zh: 这一决策正在产生回报，为我们的客户创造价值，这是最重要的。

segments.en: And what's also very exciting is we're not done here. Just in the second quarter, we announced partnerships with Google and TPUs, with Broadcom and financing chips, with Anthropic and deploying their technology.
segments.zh: 更令人兴奋的是，我们并未止步。第二季度，我们宣布了与谷歌TPU、博通芯片融资以及Anthropic技术部署的合作。

segments.en: We continue to see a lot of opportunity in this space to generate favorable returns.
segments.zh: 我们持续看到这一领域有大量机会，能够带来可观回报。

segments.en: We announced a couple of big sales in the last few weeks, one of data centers for $8 billion.
segments.zh: 过去几周我们宣布了几笔大额出售，其中一笔数据中心交易价值80亿美元。

segments.en: We announced yesterday a battery storage company we sold for $7 billion.
segments.zh: 昨天我们宣布出售一家电池储能公司，交易额70亿美元。
